title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - ScriptTable
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/ScriptTable. This class allows modelling the triggering of a series of actions by executing scripts.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ScriptTable'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

storesScript.description: Relationship. [COSEM] Specifies the different scripts which are stored in a script table.

hasObis.description: Property. [COSEM/IEC 62056] OBIS code uniquely identifying this script table COSEM object.
